_comment: 情境配音台词表。key = 文件名(不含 .mp3)，value = [台词, 语速]。由 tools/gen_vo_lines.py 用 edge-tts 合成，voice_lines 与 story.json 的 vo 字段通过 key 关联。
vo_act1_intro: Good morning! Wake up, sleepyhead! Rise and shine!
vo_act1_5_intro: Good morning! Time to drink water! A warm cup for your tummy!
vo_act1_5_action: Pick up the cup! Drink, drink, gulp gulp!
vo_act1_5_done: All done! Good job! You drank water!
vo_timeout_act1_5: Tap the cup! Let's drink water!
vo_act2_intro: Time to brush your teeth! Let's get the toothpaste!
vo_act3_intro: Water on! Let's wash your face!
vo_timeout_act3: Rub the towel to wash your face!
vo_act4_intro: Look outside, it's sunny! Put on your shirt!
vo_act4_wrong: Oh no! Phew! Too hot! Not the heavy coat! Put on the yellow shirt!
vo_act4_done: Awesome! You put on your shirt!
vo_timeout_act4: Where is the yellow shirt? Tap it!
vo_act4_5_intro: Almost dressed! Now put on your pants!
vo_act4_5_wrong: Oops! Those are not pants! Find the blue pants!
vo_act4_5_done: Great! Pants are on! You look so cool!
vo_timeout_act4_5: Find the blue pants and drag them over!
vo_act5_intro: Left shoe, right shoe! Put on your shoes!
vo_act5_shoe_l: Put on the left shoe! Snap!
vo_act5_shoe_r: Put on the right shoe! Snap!
vo_act5_done: One, two, ready to run! Shoes are put on!
vo_timeout_act5: Drag the shoe to your foot!
vo_act6_checklist: Wait! Check the list! Tap the badges!
vo_act6_finish: All done! Give me a high-five! Let's go to school!
vo_timeout_act6: Tap the glowing badge to check!
